def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    horizontal = any(all(v == 1 for v in row) for row in grid)
    if horizontal:
        cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 1 for v in row)]
        sections = [grid[:cuts[0]], grid[cuts[0]+1:cuts[1]],
                    grid[cuts[1]+1:cuts[2]], grid[cuts[2]+1:]]
        yellow = sections[0]
        a = sections[2][0][0]
        b = sections[3][0][0]
        yellow = [row[:] for row in yellow]
    else:
        cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 1 for r in range(h))]
        sections = []
        bounds = [0, cuts[0], cuts[1], cuts[2], w]
        for i in range(4):
            lo = bounds[i] + (1 if i else 0)
            hi = bounds[i+1]
            sections.append([row[lo:hi] for row in grid])
        yellow = sections[0]
        a = sections[2][0][0]
        b = sections[3][0][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(len(yellow)) if any(v == 4 for v in yellow[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(yellow[0])) if any(yellow[r][c] == 4 for r in range(len(yellow)))]
    yellow = [row[min(cols):max(cols)+1] for row in yellow[min(rows):max(rows)+1]]
    n = len(yellow)
    out = []
    for row in yellow:
        z = [1 if row[i] == 0 else 0 for i in range(3)]
        motif = [z[0] | z[1], z[1] & z[2], z[1] | z[2]]
        line = []
        for j in range(n):
            line.extend(b if motif[k] else a for k in range(3))
            if j != n - 1:
                line.append(b)
        out.append(line)
    return out
